override.cancelBookingHint: Okusazaamu kiraga nti booking n’akakiiko kaayo nga byasaziddwamu, kizzaayo obwannannyini obw’emirimu eri omukwanaganya, era kireka omuzimbi okuddamu okubookinga okukulembera kuno.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Sazaamu booking eno? Akakiiko kaayo nako kasaziddwamu. Kino kiwandiikibwa n’erinnya lyo n’ensonga yo.

detail.disputeOpen: Enkaayana ku bwannannyini ziggule ku kasitoma ono - munne omulala agamba nti eyiye. Kisalibwawo ku lupapula lwa Enkaayana.

cancellation.title: Booking esaziddwamu
cancellation.hint: Booking ne commission yaayo bisazibwamu; operational ownership ekomyewo ne partner era omuzimbi asobola okuddamu booking lead eno.

disputes.title: Enkaayana ku bwannannyini
disputes.hint: Omubeezi eyagaanibwa okuwandiisa kwe ng’okukoppa asobola okukaayana ani nnannyini kasitoma. Weekenneenye enjuyi zombi osalewo.
